answer: Sybil resistance here rests on one mechanism: every identity must escrow a non-transferable stake before it may attest peers, and identities funded from the same source are slashed as a single cluster. Faking a crowd therefore costs that stake times every clone, not once, and one correlation finding burns the whole set at once. The price acts like a pigment staining each duplicate, so a rented garden of voices cannot afford to persist and no fake majority can bridge into real influence.
